three_pressure_plate_help.speaker: Atena
three_pressure_plate_help.text: Seems like these doors are hard shut.

three_pressure_plate_help.speaker: Atena
three_pressure_plate_help.text: But I've heard a rumour amongst the gods...

three_pressure_plate_help.speaker: Atena
three_pressure_plate_help.text: To open the door you ought to find 3 pressure plates.

three_pressure_plate_help.speaker: Atena
three_pressure_plate_help.text: One is above and one is below...

atena_alert.speaker: Atena2
atena_alert.text: You're close to achieving your goal.

atena_alert.speaker: Atena2
atena_alert.text: But be wary, for the hardest part of the journey awaits you.

atena_alert.speaker: Atena2
atena_alert.text: Might you go on to defy Zeus, be prepared.

atena_alert.speaker: Atena2
atena_alert.text: Be careful to avoid his lightning bolts!

atena_alert.speaker: Atena2
atena_alert.text: Be ruthless, use your fire to fight back!

atena_alert.speaker: Atena2
atena_alert.text: Good luck, Prometheus. Help your people.

zeus_fight.speaker: Zeus
zeus_fight.text: If it isn't Prometheus the Saviour.

zeus_fight.speaker: Zeus
zeus_fight.text: Trying to help those puny little humans.

zeus_fight.speaker: Zeus
zeus_fight.text: Those pests that don't even respect me.

zeus_fight.speaker: Zeus
zeus_fight.text: But you're the worst of all Prometheus...

zeus_fight.speaker: Zeus
zeus_fight.text: You're the one who stabbed me in the back and hurt my dignity.

zeus_fight.speaker: Zeus
zeus_fight.text: Very well then. So be it.
